Evidence is therefore scoped to the same automation run rather than requiring the HEAD and R2 second request in one capture.SDK 啟動後會非同步完成 latency probe，結果可沿用到後續 request；因此以同一次 Automation 為證據邊界，不強迫 HEAD 與 R2 第二包發生在同一個 capture。

IPv6 on App LaunchApp 啟動時取得 IPv6NET-01
P1NOT RUN未執行
Android has no usable global IPv6 address on the current networkAndroid has no usable global IPv6 address on the current network

Cold-launch the App on network A, wait 10 seconds for the Appier adx6 net probe, and then request an ad.在 network A 冷啟動 App，等待 10 秒讓 Appier adx6 net probe 完成，再觸發廣告。

Connection type is Wi-Fi; the Appier probe response and ext.device.ipv6 are the same valid IPv6. The Round is BLOCKED when the network cannot reach the IPv6-only endpoint.conntype=wifi；Appier probe response 與 ext.device.ipv6 都是合法 IPv6 且完全相同。若網路無法連到 IPv6-only endpoint，整輪 BLOCKED。

IPv6 after Wi-Fi SwitchWi-Fi 切換後更新 IPv6NET-02
P1NOT RUN未執行
Android has no usable global IPv6 address on the current networkAndroid has no usable global IPv6 address on the current network

Keep the App open, switch from network A to network B, wait 10 seconds after reconnection, and request another ad.不重開 App，從 network A 切到 network B；確認連線後等待 10 秒再觸發廣告。

The same Appium/App session is preserved. The new Appier probe response equals ext.device.ipv6 and differs from network A.同一 Appium／App session；新的 Appier probe response 等於 ext.device.ipv6，且不同於 network A。

IPv6 after Network Recovery網路恢復後更新 IPv6NET-03
P1NOT RUN未執行
Android has no usable global IPv6 address on the current networkAndroid has no usable global IPv6 address on the current network

Keep the App open, disable Wi-Fi for 10 seconds, reconnect, confirm Internet access, wait another 10 seconds, and request an ad.App 保持開啟；Wi-Fi 關閉 10 秒後恢復，確認可上網，再等待 10 秒觸發廣告。

The App does not crash. After recovery, the Appier probe succeeds and its response equals the current ext.device.ipv6.App 不 crash；恢復後 Appier probe 成功，response 等於目前 ext.device.ipv6。

IPv6 after Rapid Wi-Fi Switching快速切換 Wi-Fi 後的 IPv6NET-04

In the same App session, rapidly switch A→B→A→B, remain on B, wait 10 seconds, and request an ad.同一 App session 快速執行 A→B→A→B，最後停在 B，等待 10 秒觸發廣告。

The App does not crash or hang. The final probe response and ext.device.ipv6 both equal network B and do not retain network A.App 不 crash／卡住；最終 probe response 與 ext.device.ipv6 都等於 network B 的 IPv6，不得保留 A。

Confirm a 1–2 second Charles throttle, keep the App open while switching Wi-Fi, wait 15 seconds, and request an ad.確認 Charles 已套用 1～2 秒延遲；App 保持開啟並切換 Wi-Fi，等待 15 秒後觸發廣告。

The App does not crash or hang and the probe does not block the ad request. The probe response and ext.device.ipv6 are the current network's valid IPv6.App 不 crash／卡住，ad request 不被 probe 阻擋；probe response 與 ext.device.ipv6 是目前網路的合法 IPv6。

Setup設定

Use the same path as the positive GAID testcase: Settings → Security and privacy → Privacy controls → Ads. Select Delete advertising ID on the modern UI or enable Opt out on the legacy UI. Reopen the Ads page through the same path to prove the disabled state, cold-launch the App for capture, and restore it through the same path afterward.沿用正向 GAID TC 的路徑：Settings → Security and privacy → Privacy controls → Ads。現代 UI 選擇 Delete advertising ID；舊版 UI 開啟 Opt out。動作後重新走同一路徑回 Ads 頁確認停用狀態，再冷啟動 App 抓包；完成後以同一路徑還原。

Expected預期

The Ads page visibly shows that the Advertising ID is disabled (Renew/Get new on the modern UI, or Opt out ON on the legacy UI). req/ext device.ia must be absent, empty, or the zero UUID and must not contain a usable GAID.Ads 頁清楚顯示 Advertising ID 已停用（現代 UI 顯示 Renew/Get new，或舊版 Opt out ON）；req/ext device.ia 必須不存在、為空字串或全零 UUID，不得是可用 GAID。

The Sample App's per-app Settings switch must be OFF, and the same-app API surface must show ATT denied and the zero IDFA. Request and Extended device.ia must each be absent, empty, or the zero UUID. notDetermined and restricted are not denied.Settings 的 Sample App 個別開關為 OFF，Sample App API 顯示 ATT denied 與全零 IDFA；Request／Extended 的 device.ia 各自必須不存在、為空或全零 UUID。notDetermined／restricted 不得視為 denied。
